entries.fe125918206c0e20: A business that operates the accommodation-focused business hotel "HOTEL AZ" along suburban arterial roads and similar locations, and also runs restaurants attached to the hotels; it is the only category the securities report lists as a reportable segment. As of November 30, 2025, it operates 91 HOTEL AZ locations (88 directly operated, 3 franchised). Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 (total of reportable segments) were ¥19,104 million (108.7% of the same period of the previous year). The securities report cites the effect of the dominant strategy and measures to strengthen online sales as having kept accommodation use solid, the June price revision as having raised the average spend per guest in the second half, and the opening of 4 new locations as reasons for the increase in sales. Because there is only one reportable segment, segment profit is not stated.
entries.ff2451ff230274d9: The division of family restaurants and similar establishments attached to HOTEL AZ locations. In addition to the Company's original restaurants, it operates "Shabu-shabu Onyasai" and "Kamadoka" as a franchisee of Nisul Co., Ltd., and "Joyfull" as a franchisee of Joyfull Co., Ltd. Net sales for the fiscal year ended November 2025 were ¥4,556 million (113.2% of the same period of the previous year).
